load_clip_model: load a CLIP model by name like ViT-B/32 to a specified device with optional JIT compilation
tokenize_texts: tokenize a string or list of strings into a tensor with start and end tokens
list_available_models: list all available CLIP model names such as RN50, ViT-B/16, and ViT-L/14
download_clip_checkpoint: download a CLIP model checkpoint from a URL with SHA256 checksum verification and progress bar
transform_image: create a torchvision transform pipeline that resizes, crops, normalizes a PIL image for CLIP input
